scene_description: Four people — two adults and two children — are sitting on chairs around a campfire in a fire pit. There is a green tent behind them and trees in the background. One child is holding a stick over the fire.

questions.question: What is in the middle of the people?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the round pit in the center of the picture.

questions.question: What is the child holding over the fire?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the child's hands near the fire.

questions.question: Where are the people sitting?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the trees and ground behind the people.

questions.question: Who is sitting closest to the tent?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the person sitting on the right side near the green tent.

questions.question: What color is the tent?
questions.evidence_hint: Look behind the people for the tent.
